scope: RewindBox GameCube/Wii Pocket Originals (PR #155, integrated linearly by the integration session): assets/skins/pocket gains two packs built by tools/skins/build_pocket_board_originals.py from the pixels of the maintainer-approved RewindBox boards docs/design/pocket/approved-gamecube.png and approved-wii.png (the maintainer's three input PNGs are pixel-identical crops of them, docs/evidence/pocket-originals/board-originals/inputs.json). The boards' console wordmarks are kept as approved and labelled: console names and marks belong to their owners. No third-party artwork or font bundled. The existing wii-pocket, gamecube-pocket and ps2-pocket archives are byte-identical. No hosted package, dependency, framework, engine, Core or vendored native source change.
